name: Sync Repos
description: Fetches every repo under the Workshop repo root and fast-forwards clean main/master checkouts. Repos with local work are fetched only, so origin refs stay current without touching your branches.
taskPrompt:
Sync all local repos against origin and report results:

```
bash ~/.claude/scripts/sync-repos.sh
```

Report the full output. Call out any repo that failed to fetch or that diverged from origin. If everything was already up to date, say so in one line.
